secondLife.title: Second-life desk
secondLife.intro: Every returned item gets one repeatable decision: the mandatory refurbishment, at most one condition upgrade, a new price, and the first person on the waiting list it fits.

secondLife.upgrade.forListing: Upgrade {from} → {to} for {cost}: the value rises by {gain}, more than the cost, and the item reaches the condition the catalogue needs.
secondLife.reason.list_available: Nobody on the waiting list fits, so the item goes back to the catalogue for anyone.
secondLife.reason.parts_bin: Even with one upgrade it cannot be listed, or it would finance under €300, so it is kept for parts.
